spec.side: wide (the rotating book) contrib sink, kept per month
spec.units: total_*_bp are sums of monthly bp contributions (x1e4 of the month's weight-return term); annualised_net_bp = total_net * 12 / months

honest: the monthly net is the repair's contribution in that decision month; it is not a tradable month return and no month is a tradeable statement on its own
a month whose gross is inside the tolerance is counted as having no motion, so the within/across split is measured on months that actually repaired something
months_net_against_total is empty when the era's net is inside the tolerance: a zero net has no direction to oppose
descriptive census only: no gate, no prereg, no trial count
